messages.text: Volleyball ends at 5:35 today, not 5:15. Can you still get me?
Yes. I moved the AWS practice set to after dinner so I can be there on time.
Thanks. Also I need the blue pencils from Blick if we pass it.
We can stop for 10 minutes. I need to be back by 7:30 for the architecture review notes.
Can we stop by the big place on Woodward after volleyball Saturday? I want to try that hallway window shot again.
Do I need anything for the volleyball volunteer form or is it just Mom's signature?
Just Mom's signature. The household-history boxes were all the usual blanks, same as camp last summer.
Yes. Bring the 35mm lens. We can sit near the court with the big walls first, then you can work on shadows.
Also the blue-and-yellow flower one if it is open? My sketch looked weird.
Good. Also there is a city Q&A table in the school lobby again. They had charts with call categories and response times.
That room is worth another look. I may put on the trumpet record when we get home and sort the photos slow.
If they have the outcome sheet, grab a photo. The chart without follow-through numbers does not tell much.
Can we still do the quick photo walk after volleyball or is work still being weird?
Still weird, but yes. I need 25 minutes outside and a camera strap more than another refresh of the dashboard.
Good. I found a spot by the library with reflections in the windows.
Perfect. Text me when you are done and I will drive over instead of sitting here replaying the same risk list.
Can you grab me after robotics at 7:20? The drivetrain thing is still not behaving.
Yes. I am coming straight from the garage, so ignore the old hoodie and dust.
That is basically your robotics pickup uniform anyway.
As long as it has pockets and I can wash it after dinner, it works.
I can take Mom's portal call at 2:30 from my office, but I have to send the reading-grants newsletter draft right after.
Thanks. I can cover Dad's monitor question tonight and still make the robot-kit group by 4:45.
Of course you can. You inherited the spreadsheet habit and the fix-the-room-before-anyone-asks habit.
Send me the portal notes when you have them. I'll keep the evening clear after the kids pack up.
Dad the art store has the good marker set for $38 and my sketch pad is basically gone.
Grab it if you need it for class. Use the family card and text me the receipt.
Okay. Also the car place called Mom about $407 for the tire thing?
I saw it. I moved that amount from savings before lunch, so the card balance will still clear Friday.
Can you pick me up from volleyball and stop at CVS? My ankle is still being dramatic.
Can we do the old-photo thing for your day? I found the one with tiny you in the green sweatshirt.
Yes. I need the small bottle of ibuprofen anyway. We are almost out after my shoulder yesterday.
Only if you skip the haircut jokes. That photo was probably in Troy, maybe at the house with the maple tree.
Also Mom said don't let me talk you into the giant soda.
Deal. Also Mom said no buying 47 candles because she is not cleaning wax off the cake plate again.
Fair. I am grabbing that and a 6-pack of LaCroix, then home.
Fair. One candle is enough, and the Troy photo can stay in the slideshow.
Can you send me the river picture from Saturday? The one with the bridge reflection.
Uploaded that one with the two garage shots. I kept the school fundraiser post on the other app so your mom can find it.
The reflection one is better than the car hood one, sorry.
Fair. I also saved the Free Press piece about the Rouge exhibit for our next photo walk.
Still need a second pair of hands Saturday for that rear brake line?
Yes, if you can spare an hour. I want to get the leak sorted before I try anything farther than the Woodward loop.
I can do 10. Are you buying the line kit now or doing the usual wait-until-the-household-spreadsheet-says-yes dance?
Spreadsheet says line kit only. The trim pieces can stay ugly another month.
For that school family-history thing, do I put Bates from Yorkshire and Mom's side from Cork again?
Use the Bates side from Yorkshire, plus Grandma's Wilhelm line from Hanover. Megan can help with her side after dinner.
There is also a checkbox asking about that extra origin question. I think ours is no?
Yes, same as my old school forms. I can show you the folder with baptism and confirmation papers if you need dates.
Mom found another envelope from East Lansing in Dad's desk. Do you still want anything with the green-and-white seal?
Yes, keep it in the folder with my old course sheets. Some of those CIS numbers are useful when HR asks for history.
Of course your folder is tabbed by semester. Also found a printed list of Tigers cards with tiny columns.
That list was my first real table project. Please do not let Mom toss it before I scan it.
The nonprofit board packet has a short item on school boundaries and bus access. Want me to forward it before you fill out your ballot notes?
Yes, send it. I am comparing that with the county data on stops and response times, plus the clinic closure map by ZIP.
Very you: three tabs open and a precinct guide. Mom would approve.
I already put $75 toward the legal aid fund Dave mentioned. Tonight I just want my notes solid before the absentee envelope goes back.
Coach moved us to court 3 until 6:20. Mom said you're home today?
Home today, yes. I can get you, then we will keep plates warm until Evan gets back.
Can I eat upstairs after? Loud day.
Yes. Ten minutes at the table so we can line up tomorrow, then upstairs is fine.
Friday still good? Priya says Terraforming Mars only if you swear we are not seeing midnight.
7:15 here. I already sorted the player trays, but Ticket to Ride is on standby if people fade.
Fine. I will bring chips and my usual terrible railway judgment.
Megan asked me to leave a corner of the TV visible for the Tigers score, so the table setup may be lopsided.
Do I need to bring the blue card to the 4:20 thing or do you have it?
I have the card and the HSA one. Leaving the office at 3:55 and finishing the last call from home after.
Ok. Can we stop for sketch paper after if it is quick?
Yes, quick stop is fine. The visit should only leave the usual $35 on the HSA card.
Shop is running long. The arm keeps skipping when we test it.
I can do 6:40. Cleats are already in the trunk in case the field time holds.
Can you grab Claire first? She said gym ends at 5:55 and she has that poster tube.
Yes. I will swing by East Hills, then back to BHS. Text me if the build room locks early.
Can we stop at Kroger after robotics? I need bananas and those protein bars.
Yes. I need sauce, flour, and vegetables anyway. Keeping Sunday useful.
Useful as in the loud pan thing again?
Maybe. If the week keeps poking at me, I am giving the oven something to do.
Mom asked if you can look at the portal thing Sunday. Are you buried tonight?
A little. The Azure window slipped, and the dashboard started throwing red after the Jira change moved to approved.
So dinner at your keyboard again. Classic.
Probably until 8:30. I already hit 47 for the week, but if the alert clears I can do Mom's login Sunday morning.
Before Sunday, can you add the volleyball fee and the furnace deposit? I put both receipts in the kitchen drawer.
Yep. The house line already has $1,850 sitting there, so the furnace part will not hit checking all at once.
Good. The February total still made my eyes twitch.
Same. It landed at $10,482 after the card cleared; March should look more like our usual tabs if nothing weird breaks.
Mom asked if you had looked at the county packet yet. She is very focused on the library section, unsurprisingly.
I printed that and the water authority piece last night. The glossy mailers are useless; I want the boring chart with costs and dates.
Mom asked if you still had space for Dad's recliner during the carpet work. I told her your upstairs room is not magically empty.
Correct. It is Claire's photo supply overflow plus the treadmill we allegedly use. We can store the recliner in the garage for two weeks.
Of course you do. I am checking the school board forum recap after Dad's portal stuff.
Send it when you have it. I am trying to avoid the loudest yard-sign people and see who can actually run the thing.
That works. Also, when we split the cardiology portal stuff, I can cover anything Mom puts on my card and you can just send half after your Friday bills clear.
Deal. Friday is house, Traverse, and the card statement sweep, so Saturday is cleaner.
Did you keep the one where the trees made a tunnel over the path?
Yes. Cropped out the sign and fixed the sky a little.
That one should go in your little IG batch, not the bench one.
Agreed. I will put up two tonight and leave the rest alone.
I put the Delta and ANA alerts in the shared folder. The late-March prices are not friendly yet.
Thanks. I moved the refund into the separate bucket this morning instead of letting it disappear into groceries.
Good. Also, Evan's school calendar says spring break lines up better next year than the year after.
That may be our window if the numbers stop looking ridiculous.
Mom asked whether you four are still coming Sunday, or if Megan's evening thing at the high school moved again.
Mom forwarded another link from Facebook about Dad's appointment prep. I would rather use the U-M handout from his portal.
Still coming. Evan has robotics until 4, Claire is bringing sketch stuff, and Megan said the high school slot ends at 5:30.
Agreed. Send me the portal PDF and I can print it at the Bloomfield library after work.
Good. I will tell Mom to set the big table and not pretend six people fit at the little one.
That little table lost the argument sometime around our Royal Oak days.
Thanks. Also, Michigan's site says the spring dose timing is different for Dad than for us. Can you ask Dr. Kline when you message him?
I'll message him tonight and keep it to the U-M sheet plus the state page for Mom. Less noise.
Before you head out, can you put the cuff case back in the hall closet? Claire thought it was a camera bag.
Done. I wrote this morning's number on the card too.
Thanks. Also please use the raised laptop stand today; yesterday you slid back into couch-email posture.
Fair. Stand, footrest, and the two floor exercises before I open Slack.
Can we do the photo loop after dinner? The light by Quarton Lake looked good yesterday.
Yes, short loop. I need to stretch out from sitting all day anyway.
Bring the small camera? Also your shoes, not the work ones.
Deal. If Dave confirms Saturday morning, I should keep my legs loose this week.
Dr. Hsu's office moved Dad's reading review to Friday at 10:20. Can you pull the portal notes tonight?
Yes. I can do it after dinner. If Mom calls about the password again, tell her I taped the hint inside the blue folder.
Perfect. I can call them Friday after the appointment, but I can't get over there from Ann Arbor before then.
No problem. I was planning to swing by Sunday anyway and can check the printed numbers with them.
Practice ended early but Coach is making us wait by the main doors.
On Woodward now. I have your camera bag and the black sketchbook.
Thank you. Also Evan forgot his music folder on the table again.
I will drop you home, then run it to BHS before his 7:30 pickup.
Terraforming Mars next Thursday, or are you getting eaten by the laptop again?
Next Thursday should work. This week is Python cleanup, two SQL checks, and a ServiceNow item that won't die.
You make board games sound less complicated than your actual day.
No second evening commitment, just the same badge and a release week. If it stays quiet, I'm done around 5:45.
Game night Saturday still? I have one more map in me unless your civic homework eats the whole weekend.
Still on. I just need 30 minutes before you arrive to mark the state senate and transit proposal rows.
You reading every questionnaire again?
Only the ones that answer how they would pay for it. Big promises with no schedule go in the discard pile.
Game night still Friday or did your new ladder-climbing homework eat it?
Friday stays. I passed on the role that was all budget meetings and approvals, so I owe you no spreadsheet jokes.
Bold claim from the man who color-codes Terraforming Mars.
Fair. I still want the bigger seat eventually, but not if it turns me into someone who never opens a repo or sees dinner.
Do we still have the tiny screwdrivers? The arm is slipping again.
Basement pegboard, second hook. I need them back by 6 because the Groveview kids are using the sensor kits tonight.
Got it. Also Aunt Laura's thing came in the mail? It has Ann Arbor return address.
Leave it on my desk, please. It is probably the sample postcard she wanted Dad to look over.
The drivetrain diagram is still on the printer. Need it for tomorrow?
Don't wait in the lot. I can get a ride with Sam after build.
Leave it there. The line routing is cleaner than half the vendor docs I read this week.
Text when you leave. I moved the 8:30 work call to the office tomorrow, so I need the car plan clear.
For my history thing, were you at MSU when everyone was doing dial-up in dorms?
lol you said that about my gearbox noise too.
Yes, and it was loud. I can show you the old campus email printout if that helps.
Ok. Is there dinner left or did Claire eat everything after volleyball
A smooth gearbox and a good side-B trumpet solo both beat another cloud status call.
Container with your name. I was short earlier about the table parts, sorry. We can sort it after you eat.
Also Grandma said you had zero addresses outside Michigan on some form. Is that useful?
Probably not for your project, but it made the form easy: Royal Oak, Troy, East Lansing, then this side of town.
Robotics pickup moved to 9:40. Also Mr. K said parents doing the regional trip need the chaperone check done by Friday.
Mine is submitted. It was basically address history plus the same yes/no boxes we always breeze through.
Cool. Did you ever send that city chart thing to Mom?
Yes. I marked the spots where they count stops but not what happened after, and where the new crisis van only lists hours staffed.
Mom asked how you always know whether a roof bill or car bill is going to wreck the month. I told her you inherited the grid-paper gene.
Tell her it is less glamorous now: bank categories, a workbook, and rules that move money before I can overthink it.
Of course there are rules. Are taxes and the college stuff in there too?
Taxes, college, retirement, holiday gifts, summer travel, house work, car work, plus the boring rainy-day column.
Dad's portal note is uploaded. Do you want me to summarize or are you already making the giant Bates spreadsheet?
Spreadsheet exists, obviously. I am trying not to run through every possible bad outcome tonight.
Call me after the kids are settled. Ten minutes, facts only, then you go chop vegetables like a normal human.
Deal. I would rather talk to you than dump it into a post where half the cousins start guessing.
Payroll portal posted mine early. I came in at $6,300 gross for February because of the extra counseling stipend.
Mine is still showing the usual $12,500 gross. That puts us around $18,800 together before anything comes out.
Good. I will keep the orthodontist and March refill line items in the HSA column for Sunday.
Thanks. Also my service date still says 03/18/2018 in the HR tile, which is weirdly useful for the form.
Papa Joe's has the good basil by the front. Also I want to take a picture of the flower buckets.
We can swing by after volleyball. I need basil, onions, and something green enough to balance the square-pan decision.
That sounds like you bargaining with yourself.
Accurate. I will buy the greens first so I behave in public.
Robotics got moved to 6. Do I still need that form you put by my backpack?
Yes, just sign the school clinic consent line and leave it on the island. Your mom checked the district note this morning.
Is this the same thing Claire had last fall?
Same kind of school paperwork. I matched the date against the CDC schedule before breakfast, so we are not guessing.
Robotics fee reminder says $185 by Monday. Forgot to tell you.
Forward it to me. I can send it tonight from checking.
Sent. Also did you still want that college portal login from counseling night?
Yes. I want to match the portal name to the account where the monthly deposits are going.
Are Dave and Priya the ones coming tomorrow or is this the golf guy?
Dave and Priya. Golf guy is next Saturday if the weather holds.
Ok. I moved my robotics stuff off the dining table. Tigers are in the 6th btw.
Thanks. Save me the score; I am stuck matching tiny orange pieces with tiny gray pieces.
Can I leave the robotics battery pack in the garage overnight? It smells weird from soldering.
Garage is fine, but crack the side window and keep it away from the Mustang parts.
Also your knee pills are still on the kitchen counter.
Thanks. Just the ibuprofen from this afternoon; I will put it back after dinner.
front door didn't open from my phone again
Use the keypad for tonight. I moved that device onto the quiet VLAN after the porch feed started dropping.
you named a vlan quiet?
Better than the one I made in high school for the card file. That table name was worse.
Mom found the shoebox. Granddad's papers say Yorkshire twice, Grandma's side has Wilhelm and a town near Hanover.
That fits what I remember. Nothing in another language around the house except a few recipe titles nobody could pronounce.
Also found your eighth-grade ceremony photo. Same stiff haircut, same basement fellowship hall.
Please do not show Megan. I will take the certificate scan though.
The insurance renewal form wants drivers and people at this address. I have you, me, Evan, and Claire. Still correct?
Yes. Add Evan as permit only, and leave the Traverse financing info from last year unless the statement changed.
Got it. I will upload it after school. Please check the escrow notice tonight before we sign anything.
I will. Also moving the card sweep to the 16th since payday and the house draft are stacked.
I moved groceries to Saturday afternoon. Do you still want Sunday night for receipts and the car list?
Yes. I found the fuel sender for $89, but it can wait if volleyball fees hit this week.
Let's look together. Also, if you want it ready for that June lake plan, I would rather know the real total now.
Agreed. Mechanical stuff first, shiny stuff later.
Claire asked why the Oakland schools map looks so different from the Detroit health access map. Dinner topic or too heavy for a Friday?
Dinner is fine if we keep it concrete. I can show her how district lines, home prices, and clinic locations stack on the same roads.
Good. Also, the Saturday thing downtown is all over my staff chat. Are you still keeping the morning open for Dad's portal and the donation match?
Yes. I told Priya I would send money and read her notes after. I am better useful at the table and ballot box this week.
BH Masters has 8:40 open. You in, or did the Sunday bike people already claim your weekend legs?
I can do 8:40. Keeping it to one bucket first, then 18 if the back isn't cranky.
Fine, responsible Stanley. I booked two. No heroic walking the whole course unless you want to complain by hole 13.
Cart on the back nine sounds smarter. I still want to get my steps in before lunch.
Still need me to hold the fender while you line it up?
Yes, 10:30 if you can. Wear something you do not care about.
So normal Saturday clothes for your garage, got it.
Exactly. Mine already have the washer-fluid mark from last time.
Game night next Friday or are you doing the annual Royal Oak nostalgia dinner with Megan?
Dinner is Saturday. Friday works if we start after I get Evan from soccer and Claire's ride is covered.
Nineteen rounds of that dinner and you still schedule around kid pickup. Respect the spreadsheet.
Megan already has it blocked between her parent meetings and my pickup run.
Are you and Claire taking the good camera again or can I use the big SD card for robotics?
Taking it to Independence Oaks for a bit. I can leave you the 64GB card.
Cool. Don't make me pose next to moss if I end up coming.
No promises. Claire already has opinions about the boardwalk.
Mom put the library millage thread in the cousins group again. I am not touching the replies.
Same. I read the county writeup and the library board page, then left the family thread at a thumbs-up.
That may be the most you possible answer.
I did post Dad's birthday photo there so Aunt Kathy sees it. That app still earns its keep once in a while.
Mom asked why you were reading about the Bergen rail line at lunch. I told her you were probably making a spreadsheet, because of course.
Guilty. Four tickets plus hotels makes the spreadsheet necessary, not optional.
Fair. Just do it while the kids still want to be seen with you in public.
That clock is very much part of the math.
Are we leaving for their house before or after I finish the CAD thing?
After. I just need thirty minutes there to fix the TV input, put Dad's charger back where he can find it, and look at Mom's mail stack.
Cool. Do I need to bring anything?
Just the casserole bag from the fridge. We should still be home before the Tigers start.
Dad's monitor note posted. Mom wants one of us on speaker when she opens it.
I can do 4:40 before Claire pickup. Working from home, but I have a cloud review at 5:15.
That works. Please tell Megan I am sorry for dropping this right before dinner traffic.
No problem. We will put it on tonight's kitchen list and keep dinner simple.
Mom asked whether your portal posted the March draw yet. Apparently she thinks everyone needs a medical spreadsheet now.
It posted. Dr. Kline's office just said keep the same tiny morning tablet and repeat labs in six months.
That sounds boring, which is the best kind of update. Are you still doing those floor moves after long desk days?
Most nights. The new chair setup makes it easier to stay consistent.
MSU watch party Saturday or are you still doing family cake duty?
Both. Cake early, game after. Megan vetoed your idea of 47 green-and-white cupcakes.
Weak. Bring the old East Lansing hoodie then, the one from before we knew better.
It survived Troy basements and too many moves, so yes.
Still on for boards tomorrow, or did the work thing eat your weekend?
Still on. I put the cleanup list in order and did a hard stop at 5:30 so I would not keep circling it.
Good. Bring Terraforming Mars if your brain can handle watching me win slowly.
Only if you answer your phone if I need a sanity check before I leave the laptop closed.
Robotics pickup got pushed to 8:40. Mentor stayed late for drivetrain.
Got it. I will do the TOGAF flashcards from the parking lot and then head in when you text.
You have flashcards for work stuff now?
For the next exam and for the junior admin lunch series. Same reason I make you explain your wiring choices.
Mom found Dad's old neighborhood-watch folder and asked if you wanted it. It is mostly phone-tree stuff and one note about your bike being returned in 1994.
Mom says Dad's portal locked her out again. Are you okay handling that after work?
That may be the full Bates family archive of official drama, honestly. Keep the phone tree if she wants a laugh.
Yes. I may take ten minutes on Woodward first if traffic is not awful. The room with the murals resets my head.
Ha. Also our nonprofit is co-hosting that county forum on complaint review and public dashboards. You still want the livestream link?
Very Stanley: fix the login after staring at walls older than my nonprofit's database.
Please. I want to hear whether they explain who reviews repeat complaints and whether the training numbers are tied to actual results.
Add a camera, a quiet bench, and maybe Miles on the drive home, and I can face another password screen.
For social studies can I use the photo we took by 8 Mile where the sidewalks just stop?
Yes, use that one and the clinic bus-stop photo. Put the captions in your own words and mention where Bloomfield changes into Detroit on the map.
Ms. H said we can include family interviews. Can I quote you about voting for boring local stuff because it actually changes street-level things?
You can say I read the local language, donate when I can, and talk it through at home before I mark anything.
Dad can you not put the train map where my photo paper is drying
Moving it now. Dave is only dropping by after nine holes, so I do not need the whole table yet.
Cool. Also Mom said the Tigers start before dinner so I get the couch corner with the outlet.
Deal. I will keep the green chairs out of your art zone.
Can I use the porch clip from 3:12 for my light/shadow sketch? The package guy made a funny silhouette.
Yes, but crop the address. I saved that feed to the house folder, same place as the switch map.
Also your old green folder is on the scanner. It has MSU stuff and a sheet that says CIS 320.
Leave it there, please. I need the course list before I put the folder back.
I tagged you under that Mustang carb photo. Ten replies already, including one guy diagnosing it from a blurry thumbnail.
Saw it. I'll answer the useful gasket question and ignore the rest.
Also sent you that supplier article. It was on my work feed, not behind a paywall.
Thanks. I saved it with the Ben Thompson post and the ACM note for Monday.
Tigers opener planning: Royal Oak Brewery or your place?
Your call. If brewery, I am good for one pint and then iced tea. Early soccer pickup next morning.
Very Stanley. I will warn the bartender not to expect heroics.
Also remind me to bring ibuprofen for my back, not the whole medicine shelf.
Mom's portal shows Dad's monitor copay posted. It says $412. Do you want me to wait until you and Megan talk?
No need. Pay it and I'll send you my half today.
Of course you have a category for "Dad heart widgets."
The category is boring, but it keeps March from touching the long-term stuff.
Claire's camp portal copied your old household info from the district. It has the first box marked and no on the follow-up origin line. Still right?
Yes, that is the same way I fill it out. I will review the rest after groceries.
It also asks for a place we attend, but I left it blank unless you want the Troy place from your childhood.
Blank is fine. We only go when family needs something or it is a holiday.
Photo walk after lunch? The light by the trail was good yesterday.
Works for me. I will bring the gray jacket with the big pockets for the spare lens.
The one with the tiny burn mark from the garage heater?
That one. It still zips and it carries the gear.
Game night question: am I bringing chips or are you doing the dangerous rectangle again?
Neither before 6. I have a Costco refill pile, then Kroger for the sane items, then the stove gets my bad mood.
So chips are backup and I pretend not to notice the corner math.
Correct. If I cut small enough, we can all maintain plausible deniability.
Saw your two creek shots. Very moody. Did Claire approve the final picks?
She vetoed the crooked bridge one and was right.
Oakland County tourism owes you a coffee at this point.
I would settle for fewer muddy shoes in the car.
Can you check whether your robotics build season has any hard dates posted for March break next year?
Not yet. Why
Trying not to put refundable deposits on top of a competition weekend. One route has us changing planes in Haneda.
Ok I'll ask Monday. If this means I need a new passport photo, warn me first.
Can we take the old car to the park for photos when the weather is nicer? The blue paint looks cool with the trees.
Maybe after I fix the gauge and seat belts. I do not want you stranded with me holding a toolbox.
Fair. Is that the box on the garage shelf or another 'after the bills' box?
Gauge is already here. Seat belts are after the bills.
Can you move robotics pickup to 8:45? Build ran long.
Yes. I am home tomorrow and Thursday anyway, so I can shift the school run and still make my 9:00 standup.
Mom said Sunday spreadsheet had a giant March number. Are we good for the parts deposit?
We are fine. Last month was about $18,800 gross together, and the HSA/clinic stuff is already carved out before extras.
Claire's pickup moved to 6:40. Can you still take it?
Yes if this ServiceNow bridge closes. I'm comparing the Azure console to the spreadsheet now.
If it turns red again, text me before I leave school.
Will do. I'm at 44 already, so I'm trying not to let tonight become another 9 pm with Teams open.
I read the two school board answers you flagged. The shorter one was less polished but actually named the counselor staffing numbers.
That is why I circled it. The other one had better slogans and somehow no plan for hiring or reporting back.
Also the science curriculum question was not subtle. I know which answer made you sigh.
I can live with imperfect. I have less patience for people who dodge evidence and then want control of classrooms.
Game night Friday, or are you teaching people how to unhide their Wi-Fi again?
Friday works. Library table is Wednesday this week, Groveview was yesterday, and Laura has me checking one paragraph before her print deadline.
Naturally. You are the only guy who can turn a board-game invite into a routing chart.
Routing chart prevents me from forgetting someone. I'll bring Ticket to Ride and the good snacks.
Can you get the black poster board? Megan said her building ran out and I need it after volleyball.
Yes. I will grab it after Evan's pickup and leave it on the kitchen counter.
Also she put the conference-night paper on the fridge. She said you would miss it if it was under the toaster.
Fair. Fridge wins. Text when practice is actually ending.
Can you cover the 5:20 East Hills pickup? Claire has the art portfolio and her gym bag.
Yes. I will leave by 4:55 and bring the extra water bottle.
Thanks. Evan's BHS thing shifted to 7:15, and he asked if you can bring the small amp from the basement.
Got it. Portfolio, gym bag, water, amp, then BHS.
Claire's volleyball pickup is 7:15. Also the Henry Ford reminder came through for Saturday morning.
I saw it. I moved groceries later and added the kids' school dates from the district email.
Good. Please ignore the parent-thread screenshot unless it matches what Dr. Kline or the state page says.
Already doing that. I'll bring the printed notes from the library folder and we can update the calendar after dinner.
Game night still good? I can bring Terraforming Mars if your chair throne is ready for four hours of sitting.
Chair throne plus standing breaks. I am not repeating the 2024 dining-room mistake.
Ha. Also Megan said you have an early Walgreens run Saturday, so we can start at 6 instead of 5.
Six works. I need to pick up the refill and print the lab note for Kline anyway.
Game night still on? I can bring Terraforming Mars, assuming your city spreadsheet didn't finally consume you.
Still on. I only added three columns: complaint status, crisis-team handoff, and training metric. Very restrained.
Restraint from you is suspicious. Need me to help with parking after that Maple/Lahser warning, hardened criminal?
One orange windshield note in twenty years and now I have a reputation. Park wherever the driveway leaves room for Megan.
Game night at yours in April? Or is the dining room still Evan's robot landfill?
April works. Same four calendars to dodge, plus robotics parts. No guest setup to work around.
Look at you, running a tight ship. Still doing the deck this spring?
Only the boards that need it. Big projects wait until after the spring escrow adjustment and Megan's Traverse payment settle.
Found a dusty Zip disk labeled card inventory in my basement box. Is this yours from East Lansing?
Probably. If it has a dBase file and a bad Tigers sort order, that was mine.
Naturally. Also I am not helping you add another driveway thing unless you promise the garage switch has room.
It has room. I cleaned up the ports after the back-door battery alert kept waking Megan.
Saturday game night still on, or are you trapped doing certificate archaeology with Laura?
Still on. I found Bates, Wilhelm, and two towns I had to look up on a map. That is enough genealogy for March.
Your old church-basement paperwork finally paid off. Bring Ticket to Ride and no 3-hour rules debate.
